U3.required_finishing: Owner confirmed socket-compatible male headers are already fitted. Plug both 24-pin rows into factory-fitted J16/J17 with correct orientation/engagement; the factory fits CA1, the short shielded Micro-B pigtail. Retain the stock VIN/VUSB bridge. CA1.1 is VBUS-open and the carrier data switch qualifies attachment from host VBUS. SYS5_CORE powers VIN at J16.1. Use J28 for host service; isolate external VIN before direct Micro-B-to-host servicing. No header soldering, bridge cutting or duplicate purchase.
U3.acceptance_status: REQUIRED OWNER PLUG-IN. Compatible male headers confirmed on 19 October 2026. Native checking must verify CA1.1 NC, J16.1 SYS5_CORE and the USB switch/monitor pin-net map. Quantity allocation, orientation/engagement, unpowered continuity and powered USB qualification remain pre-use checks. No JLC header preparation or module placement in this carrier quote.

U9.required_finishing: Owner confirmed the owned RTC module already has male headers. Plug the Adafruit 3013 DS3231 module into factory-fitted J18 with the battery-holder side upward and VIN at cavity 1, after verifying the existing header direction, engagement and IC clearance. CR1220 is a separate system accessory. No owner header soldering is required.
U9.acceptance_status: REQUIRED OWNER PLUG-IN. Male headers confirmed by owner on 19 October 2026. Physical quantity allocation, existing header direction, orientation/engagement and clearance remain pre-power acceptance checks. No duplicate purchase, JLC header preparation or factory module placement in this carrier quote.
